agents.name: Interpreter
agents.role: Synthetic events -> statistics, momentum, chaos, threshold alerts

agents.name: GraphContext
agents.role: Graph grounding: shortest paths, centrality (Kevin Bacon Score), communities

agents.name: Narrator
agents.role: Grounded narration + auto recap (Azure OpenAI when configured, template fallback)

agents.name: Personalizer
agents.role: Analyst / casual / player-focus / club-focus / Spanish renderings + timed overlay

orchestration: Sequential shared-state handoffs (Microsoft Agent Framework manifest in src/agents/framework_adapter.py)
foundry_steps: In Microsoft Foundry portal: create/open the project linked to the Azure OpenAI resource from infra/main.bicep
Confirm the Phi-4-mini-instruct deployment exists (created by Bicep)
Register the four agents above with the instructions in framework_adapter.AGENT_MANIFEST
Run an evaluation on the sample fixture (outputs/sample_match_intelligence.json) and keep the run link for the submission
